description: This is a PHPUnit test class for EmployeeAnniversaryAPI, testing the API endpoints related to employee anniversaries within the OrangeHRM system. It includes test cases for retrieving all employee anniversaries and checks that create, delete, and validation methods are not implemented.

classes.name: EmployeeAnniversaryAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeAnniversaryAPI's functionality and ensuring that certain methods are not implemented.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests fetching all employee anniversary records using the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testGetAll method, data sourced from a YAML file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create method is not implemented and raises the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rules for create are not implemented.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Checks that the delete method is not implemented.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that the validation rules for delete are not implemented.
